method_rules.horizon_end: balance_date + horizon_months (month arithmetic, end of month clamped)
method_rules.run_rate_net_cash_flow_annual: operating cash flow + net cash used in investing + net cash used in financing - net debt issuance (every non-debt flow of the twelve months; new borrowing is excluded because committed undrawn funding is zero)
method_rules.maturities_in_horizon: principal of a facility whose maturity_date <= horizon_end, else 0
method_rules.amortisation_in_horizon: for a facility maturing after the horizon: min(annual_amortisation x horizon_months / 12, principal); 0 when it matures inside
method_rules.cash_at_horizon_end_before_refinancing: closing cash + run-rate over horizon - amortisation - maturities
method_rules.available_liquidity: closing cash + undrawn committed revolver (revolver commitment - revolver drawn); equals the CP-1 T4.10 liquidity fact, asserted
method_rules.resources_at_horizon_end: cash at horizon end before refinancing + undrawn committed revolver
method_rules.funding_gap: max(0, minimum cash - resources); a computed 0 is 'no gap', distinct from missing
method_rules.months_to_minimum_cash: run-rate cash flow alone (maturities and amortisation excluded; own limitation, the wall is in T2E.4/T2E.5). start = closing cash + undrawn revolver - minimum cash. Minimum cash missing: state 'missing' ('Not calculable: minimum cash not assessed'). Annual run-rate < 0: max(0, start) / (-annual / 12), 1 dp half-up. Annual >= 0: state 'not_reached' (text 'Not reached at run rate') when start >= 0, 0 months when start < 0. Revolver missing: 'not_reached' only when annual >= 0 and closing cash alone >= minimum cash (a revolver is never negative), else 'missing' ('Not calculable: revolver undisclosed'). The stored value is quantised to 1 dp ('20.0', never '2E+1')
method_rules.sources_and_uses_difference: calculated closing cash (opening + operating + investing + financing + FX) less reported closing cash; shown as a known value (zero is a known zero); a non-zero difference adds the own limitation 'Sources and uses differ from reported closing cash by <x>' and never refuses
method_rules.missing_rule: any missing operand makes the dependent value missing with a limitation; nothing defaults to 0; cash_only_headroom (excludes the revolver) is the only value that stays known when the revolver is missing
method_rules.table_signs: `derived` values are magnitudes; tables show cash outflows (amortisation, maturities) and negative balances in brackets, so a 50 maturity is shown (50); display rounds half away from zero (display.py ROUND_HALF_UP on the exact decimal), so fixture_burn's monthly (0.5) outflow is shown (1)
method_rules.months_between: largest whole number of months n with balance date + n months (end of month clamped) on or before the date
